description: Configuration and guidelines for the Gemini AI agent working on this project.

lint.description: Runs ESLint to check for code quality and style issues.

lint_fix.description: Runs ESLint and automatically fixes issues.

format.description: Runs Prettier to format all project files.

format_check.description: Runs Prettier to check for formatting issues without modifying files.

test.description: Runs the full test suite (unit, integration, regression).

validate.description: Runs a full validation suite: env check, lint, format check, and tests.

start_daemon.description: Starts all applications in daemon mode using PM2.

stop_daemon.description: Stops all applications managed by PM2.

daemon_status.description: Checks the status of applications managed by PM2.
